description: The AutoHide dock appears with a slide and fade after entering the edge trigger, then hides in the opposite direction after the cursor leaves.

assertions.comment: While the cursor stays on the edge trigger, the dock becomes fully visible after the configured ShowDelay. The real-time delay itself is not measured.
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) reaches the bottom display position y=36 when showing finishes.

When the cursor moves outside the dock, the dock becomes fully transparent after the configured HideDelay. Hiding is controlled by a real-time timer, so verify the final capture state rather than an intermediate frame.
When hiding finishes, the panel moves to y=116 outside the bottom surface. Hiding is controlled by a real-time timer, so verify the final capture state rather than an intermediate frame.
The panel appears smoothly from y=116 to y=36 with a 250ms InOutQuad slide.
As the dock appears, the panel opacity also increases smoothly from 0 to 1 over 250ms.
After the cursor leaves, the panel slides off-screen from y=36 to y=116 with the same 250ms curve.
As the dock hides, the panel opacity also decreases smoothly from 1 to 0.
